senses.gloss:
वद् वद् (sometimes lengthened in ep.
into वाद् on account of the metre), cl. 1. P.
A. वदति, वदते, उवाद (3rd du. ऊदतुस्, 3rd
[]
pl. ऊदुस्; according to Vopa-deva VIII. 52, 2nd sing.
also वेदिथ, 3rd du. वेदतुस्, 3rd pl. वेदुस्), ऊदे (3rd
du. ऊदाते, 3rd pl. ऊदिरे), वदिष्यति, -ते, अवादीत्,
अवदिष्ट, Prec. उद्यात्, वदितुम्, to speak, say,
utter, tell, speak to, address (with acc. of the thing
said and of the person addressed and sometimes with
prep. अभि and acc., both P. and A. being used
indiscriminately, e. g. यद् वदसि माम्, that which
thou sayest to me; माम् अभि वदति, he speaks
to me; किं वदामि or वदे, what must I say?
मैवं वद or वदस्व, do not speak so; स-
त्यं वद or वदस्व, speak the truth; देवानां
वचनात् त्वां वदामि or वदे, I speak to thee in
the name of the gods; प्रतिवाक्यं वद or वद-
स्व, speak a reply); to speak about, declare, proclaim,
announce, communicate, inform, notify; to maintain,
affirm; to designate, call, name; to raise the voice,
sign, utter a cry (said of birds &c.); to discuss, dispute
about, contend, quarrel (Ved. A.); to be called, be con-
sidered (Ved. A.); to state authoritatively (?), be an
authority (A.); to exert one's self, strive for (A.):
Pass. उद्यते, Aor. अवादि, Part. उदित (see 2. उदित),
to be said or spoken, to be addressed or spoken to;
to be declared or announced, to be published or
proclaimed: Caus. वादयति, -यते, -यितुम्, Aor.
अवीवदत्, to cause to speak or say, to urge or invite
to speak; to cause to sound forth, play (a musical
instrument; generally P.), to play music; to cause
to be played by any one (inst.); to speak, recite,
rehearse: Pass. of Caus. वाद्यते: Desid. विवदि-
षति, -ते, to desire to speak: Intens. वावद्यते,
वावत्ति, वावदीति, to speak aloud; to sound loudly;
[cf. Gr. ὕδ-ω, ὑδ-έ-ω, ὕδ-η-ς, ἀ(ϝ)είδ-ω, ἀοιδό-ς,
ἀοιδή, ἀηδών, (according to some) αὐδή, αὐδάω,
(perhaps also) φράζω, φραδάω: (probably) Lat. vas
(vad-is): (perhaps) Old Germ. far-wāzan: Old
Sax. for-wātan: Lith. vad-i-n-u, ‘I call:' Slav.
vad-i-ti, vāda, ‘accusation;’ us-ta, ‘mouth:’ Hib.
feadaim, ‘I say;' (perhaps) luadhaim, ‘I men-
tion;’ raidim, ‘I say.’]

वद, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, able to speak, speak-
ing well or sensibly, (frequently at the end of comps.;
cf. प्रियं-व्˚, कु-व्˚); (अस्), m., N. of a so-called
Veda (with the Magians).

वाद वाद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वद्), speaking,
talking, (काम-वाद, talking as one pleases, speak-
ing freely); discourse, speech, assertion, proposition,
allegation; statement, discussion, dispute, controversy,
words; explanation, exposition (of holy texts &c.);
demonstrated conclusion; reply; a plaint, accusation;
report, rumour; sound, sounding.
—वाद-कर, अस्,
आ, or ई, अम्, or वाद-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, making a discus-
sion, causing a dispute.
—वाद-चञ्चु, उस्, उस्, उ,
clever in repartee, a good jester.
—वाद-प्रतिवाद,
अस्, m. or औ, m. du. a set disputation, assertion and
counter assertion, statement and contradiction, con-
troversy, disputation.
—वाद-युद्ध, अम्, n. a war
of words, controversial war, controversy, dispute.
—वादयुद्ध-प्रधान, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in
the war of controversy, an eminent controversialist.
—वाद-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, adhering to or following
any particular proposition or doctrine; addicted to
controversy, disputatious.
—वाद-वादिन्, ई, m. a
Jaina (= आर्हत).
—वाद-विवाद, अस्, m. or औ,
m. du. a discussion about any statement, argument and
disputation, debate, dispute, argumentation, litigation.
—वाद-साधन, अम्, n. the proof of an assertion,
the maintaining of an argument, controversy.
—वा-
दानुवाद (˚द-अन्˚), औ, m. du. assertion and
reply, attack and rejoinder, plea and counterplea,
accusation and defence, plaint and reply, controversy,
dispute, disputation.
वदक = वद in दुर्-वदक, q. v.

वादक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. Caus. of rt. वद्), making
a speech, speaking; (अस्), m. a speaker; a musician.
वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking, saying, telling.

वदन, अम्, n. the act of speaking or saying;
sounding (Ved.); the mouth, face, countenance,
(काल-वदन, ‘the face of Time,’ N. of a Śaiva
work), aspect, appearance, look; the front, point;
the first term, initial quantity or term of a progres-
sion (in algebra); the summit or apex of a triangle;
[cf. Hib. aodann, ‘the face;’ eudan, ‘the fore-
head.’]
—वदन-दन्तुर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
—वदन-मदिरा, f. the wine or nectar of the
mouth.
—वदन-रोग, अस्, m. mouth-disease.
—वदन-श्यामिका, f. blackness of the face; a
kind of disease.
—वदन-सरोज, अम्, n. ‘face-
lotus, ‘the face of a mistress.
—वदनामय (˚न-
आम्˚), अस्, m. mouth-disease, face-sickness.
—वद-
नासव (˚न-आस्˚), अस्, m. ‘mouth-liquor,’ saliva,
spittle.
—वदनी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to
become a face, be changed into a face.
—वदनी-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, changed into a face.
—वद-
नेन्दु (˚न-इन्˚), उस्, m. ‘face-moon,’ the face.

वादन, अम्, n. the act of sounding, sound; in-
strumental music, the sound of musical instruments.
—वादन-दण्ड, अस्, m. a stick &c. for striking
a musical instrument.
वदन्त in किं-व्˚, q. v.

वदन्ति, इस्, or वदन्ती, f. speech, discourse, talk,
(according to some only used in किं-व्˚, q. v.)
वदन्तिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
वदन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = वदान्य below.

वदान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, eloquent, speaking kindly
or agreeably, affable; bountiful, liberal, munificent,
(in this sense probably for 1. अव-दान्य); (अस्),
m., N. of a Ṛṣi.

वादान्य वादान्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for वदान्य,
q. v.), munificent, liberal, &c.

वदमान, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, saying, telling;
calling; explaining, declaring; glorifying, boasting.

वदावद, अस्, आ, अम्, or वदावदिन्, ई, इनी, इ
(probably an old Intens., cf. 2. महामह), speak-
ing much, talkative, chattering, speaking, a speaker;
able to speak well, eloquent.
वदितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken.
वादितव्य, अम्, n. instrumental music.
वदितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, saying, speaking, a speaker.

वदिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. speaking very well,
speaking best.

वद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken &c., (used only
in comp., cf. अ-वद्य, अन्-अवद्य); an epithet of
the days of the dark lunar fortnight, (see वद्य-
पक्ष); (अम्), n. speech, speaking about, con-
versing, (only at the end of a comp., cf. ब्रह्म-व्˚,
सत्य-व्˚.)
—वद्य-पक्ष, अस्, m. the dark fort-
night of the lunar month (in which the moon is
waning).

वाद्य, अम्, n. any musical instrument.
—वाद्य-
कर, अस्, m. a musician.
—वाद्य-निर्घोष, अस्,
m. the sound of musical instruments.
—वाद्य-
भाण्ड, अम्, n. a multitude of musical instruments,
a band; any musical instrument.
—वाद्यभाण्ड-
मुख, अम्, n. the mouth or top part or point of
a musical instrument.

वाद्य; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), to be played on, to
be sounded; (अम्), n. a musical instrument.
वदर वदर, वदरि, &c. See बदर, &c.

वादर वादर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वदर for
बदर, q. v.), made or consisting of cotton, &c.
(see बादर); (आ), f. the cotton plant.
वदरिक, अस्, m. a jujube tree.

वादरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one who collects cotton, &c.
(See बादरिक.)

वदाम वदाम, अस्, m. (fr. the Persian
بادام), an almond.

वदाल वदाल, अस्, m. a kind of Silurus or
sheat-fish; an eddy or whirlpool.

वादल वादल, अम्, n. [cf. बादर], liquorice
or the root of the Abrus Precatorius (used for it).

वादाल वादाल, अस्, m. the sheat fish (=
वदाल, सहस्र-दंष्ट्र).
वदालक, अस्, m. = वदाल, a kind of sheat-fish.

वदि वदि, ind. (according to some for ब-
दि, contracted fr. बहुल-दिन, but cf. वद्य), in
the dark half of any month, (affixed to the names of
months in giving dates at the end of MSS.; cf.
वैशाख-व्˚.)

वादि, इस्, इस्, इ, speaking; learned; wise, sage,
skilful.
—वादि-राज्, ट्, m. a Bauddha sage; = मञ्जु-
घोष, मञ्जु-श्री.
वद्दिवास वद्दिवास, N. of a place.
वद्ध्री वद्ध्री. See under वध्र, p. 883.

वादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to speak, causing
to sound; sounding, playing a musical instrument.

वादित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus. of rt. वद्), made
to speak, caused to be uttered; made to sound,
sounded, played.

वादित्र, अम्, n. a musical instrument; instrumental
music.
—वादित्र-गण, अस्, m. a band of music.

वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking, discoursing; asserting,
declaring; disputing; (ई), m. a speaker; a disputant;
a plaintiff, accuser; an explainer, expounder (of the law,
Śāstras, &c.); the leading or key-note (in music).
—वादि-त्व, अम्, n. in सत्य-वादि-त्व.
—वादीन्-
द्र (˚दि-इन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a philosopher.

वादिश, अस्, m. a learned and good man, a sage,
seer.

वाद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being made to speak
or sound, played.

वादरङ्ग वादरङ्ग, अस्, m. the sacred fig-
tree. (See अश्वत्थ.)

वादरायण वादरायण, अस्, m., N. of Vyāsa,
(also written बादरायण, q. v.)

वादिर वादिर, अम्, n., N. of a particular
tree (resembling the Vadarī or Badarī).
